units.source_text: 两人就在昼间坐起的地方躺下来，相与谈话，不久日色已暮。

en.t: The two of them lay down in the place where they had been sitting during the day and talked together, and before long dusk had fallen.

units.source_text: 暂时蒙眬入睡，忽然鸣蜩四起，两人都被惊醒。

en.t: After dozing off for a little while, they were both startled awake when evening cicadas suddenly began crying all around them.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“那么，就在天色尚未全黑之时动身吧。”

en.t: Genji said, “Then let us set out before the sky has grown completely dark.”
He then rose and changed his clothes.

units.source_text: 三公主说道：“岂不闻‘且待东升月照归’么？”

en.t: The Third Princess said, “Have you not heard, ‘Wait until the moon rises in the east, and go home by its light’?”

units.source_text: 那娇声娇气的语调，令人闻之心醉。

en.t: The sweet, coaxing tone of her voice was enough to make anyone who heard it feel enchanted.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“她想‘赚得郎君留片刻’么？”

en.t: Genji thought, “Is she trying to coax her lord into staying a little longer?”

units.source_text: 觉得十分可怜，于是欲行又止。

en.t: Feeling deeply moved and sorry for her, he was about to leave but stopped again.
